name: Tugging at Knots
source:
Tugging at Knots is a fan-VN based off of NomnomNami's [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/treat-complete]Lonely Wolf Treat[/url] Series, acting as a continuation of the ending of Chapter 7's ending, made for Moxie's birthday, 2023!!! The fox has been getting used to her new life with her girlfriends and Treat's pack, but some things have been made that new life rather difficult to become accustomed to...

[from [url=https://blackberry-mochi.itch.io/tugging-at-knots]itch.io[/url]]
